context: Two students discuss neutral countries in a documentary
purpose: Teach: 墓/姉妹/一旦/住み/弟子/創業/国々/中立

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: このドキュメンタリー、戦時中に中立を貫いた国々を取り上げてるんだって。
lines.en: This documentary covers countries that maintained neutrality during wartime.
lines.style: Casual university student introducing a topic with mild enthusiasm.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: へえ、面白そう。スイスとスウェーデンって姉妹みたいに似た立場だったよね？
lines.en: Oh, sounds interesting. Switzerland and Sweden had similar positions, like sisters, right?
lines.style: Curious teenage girl, light and engaged casual register.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: そう。でもスウェーデンの企業の創業者の中には、裏で武器を売ってた人もいたらしい。
lines.en: Yeah. But some founders of Swedish companies apparently sold weapons behind the scenes.
lines.style: Thoughtful young man explaining historical nuance to a friend.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: えー、ひどい。じゃあ中立って言っても本当の中立じゃないじゃん。
lines.en: Ugh, that's awful. So neutral doesn't really mean neutral then.
lines.style: Disappointed teenager reacting with informal sharp tone.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 一旦止めて見て。ここ、亡くなった兵士の墓が映ってる場面、すごく重い。
lines.en: Pause it for a sec. This scene showing the fallen soldiers' graves is really heavy.
lines.style: Calm university student urging quiet reflection during a film.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 本当だ…。あ、ナレーターの人、昔ここに住みながら歴史学者の弟子として研究してたって。
lines.en: Wow, really. Oh, the narrator apparently lived here while studying as a historian's apprentice.
lines.style: Softened teenage voice reading subtitles with quiet awe.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: なるほど、だから語り方に説得力あるんだ。レポート、この視点で書こうかな。
lines.en: Ah, that's why his narration is so convincing. Maybe I'll write my report from this angle.
lines.style: Reflective university student connecting media to academic work.
